title: Gujarat has delivered real farm productivity gains, but performance remains uneven across crops, regions, and farm sizes
subtitle: This section tests how far the state’s strong commercial farm model translates into broad-based output and income gains, separating statewide progress from the district, crop, and smallholder gaps that now define the next productivity frontier.
